test_name: Verify Login Using Google OAuth Integration
description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using the Google OAuth integration available on the login page.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate the 'Login with Google' button using the provided stable selector.
Ensure the browser is redirected to the Google OAuth page.
Input valid Google account credentials (email and password) and submit.
Verify the OAuth consent screen, if prompted, and accept.
Ensure the browser is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai with a valid authentication token.
Verify that the user is logged in by checking the presence of a user-specific element on the dashboard.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google OAuth login page.
User can authenticate using valid Google credentials.
User is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai with an active session.
User-specific dashboard elements are visible after login.
edge_cases: User cancels the OAuth process on the Google consent screen.
User session expires before completing the login process.
Browser blocks third-party cookies required for OAuth.
data_requirements: OAuth client ID and secret for Google integration.
Redirect URI registered in the Google Cloud Console.
Mock data for the user dashboard.
dependencies: Registered OAuth redirect URI in Google Cloud Console.
Roost.ai backend integration with Google OAuth.
No ad-blocker or browser extension interfering with the login process.
api_interactions: GET request to Google OAuth endpoint for authentication.
POST request to Roost.ai backend to exchange OAuth token for session token.
GET request to fetch user-specific data for the dashboard.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Google OAuth login page.
Time taken for redirection back to https://dev.roost.ai.
Time taken to load the user dashboard after login.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Login with Google' button has an accessible name.
Verify proper focus management during redirection.
Check for contrast ratio compliance on the login button.
Ensure keyboard navigation works for the OAuth flow.
Validate that screen readers can announce the login process steps.
